start: First launch of the watch app with a workout open

steps.action: On "Heart rate" ("1 of 2", "Shows how hard your heart works while you rest.") tap Allow
must_not: The question asked again on the next open

steps.action: Log a set on the phone so the rest timer shows
must_not: A number when the watch has no reading yet

steps.action: Lower the wrist so the screen dims
user_sees: The heart line goes; the sensor stops
must_not: The sensor left running while dimmed

start: Heart rate allowed; a workout open with watch logging on

steps.action: Look at the next-set screen's top bar
must_not: A different number from the rest timer screen

start: First launch; the member taps Not now on "Heart rate" (or the watch has no heart sensor)

user_sees: No heart line; the column re-centres
must_not: The heart-rate question popping up mid-workout

start: Heart rate showing "♥ 132" during a rest

steps.action: Take the watch off the wrist with the screen still on
user_sees: The number goes ("♥ —") or a word that the watch is off the wrist
must_not: The last number "♥ 132" staying on as if it were live

steps.action: Close the workout on the phone
must_not: The sensor still running with no workout

start: Heart rate shown on the watch during a workout

steps.action: Ask who else gets the reading
user_sees: The reading shows only on this watch
must_not: The heart rate sent to the phone, the gym or MettleUp
The heart rate in the screen log sent with feedback
